items.title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks
items.summary: Following an October announcement, Apple has detailed new permission controls, warnings, and transparency features coming to macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agents and other apps.
items.titleZh: AI 智能体引发隐私风险之际，苹果公布 Mac 新安全控制措施
items.summaryZh: 继 10 月宣布相关计划后，苹果详细介绍了即将随 macOS 27.3 推出的新权限控制、警告和透明度功能，以应对 AI 智能体及其他应用带来的风险。

items.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
items.summary: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.
items.titleZh: 加州州检察长因失控智能体事件起诉 OpenAI
items.summaryZh: 加州的这起诉讼是首批尝试追究 AI 实验室对失控智能体事件法律责任的案件之一。

items.title: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver’s licenses during data breach
items.summary: The ride-sharing giant said driver's license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.
items.titleZh: Uber 称黑客在数据泄露事件中窃取近 15 万份驾照信息
items.summaryZh: 这家网约车巨头表示，存储在 AI 云服务公司 Fireworks AI 处的驾照信息在一次安全事件中被盗。

items.titleZh: 特朗普称英伟达前 CEO 黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍的绯闻未威胁国家安全

items.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: The industry will be ‘fine’
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.
items.titleZh: 萨姆·奥特曼谈英伟达若没有黄仁勋：行业会“没问题”
items.summaryZh: OpenAI CEO 萨姆·奥特曼承认，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在 AI 热潮中发挥了特殊作用，但他最终认为，即使没有黄仁勋掌舵，行业也会“没问题”。

items.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
items.summary: The FBI says that the open source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.

items.summaryZh: FBI 表示，这款开源黑客工具被用于针对一家美国 IT 巨头和韩国金融业的网络攻击。
